scope: Bibliographic and MSC2020 verification for the negative-results manuscript. No new mathematical experiment, theorem audit, or campaign credit is recorded here.
method: Publisher records, author or institution publication records, and published research bibliographies were consulted directly. Scope descriptions below restrict how these references may support the manuscript; they do not certify this project's mathematical claims.
